summary: Iteration 9: validated 3 new features — partial reimbursements, loan alerts, and Espacio Socios (Hub). Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (partials math, 409 validations, delete lock w/ partials, alerts severities, Hub CRUD + comments authz + filters). Frontend: /espacio flow fully works (note + credential creation, password mask + Eye toggle, search + type filter, badges). /partners alerts-banner-{partner_id} renders for Luis with severity color. Modal opens correctly. All listed acceptance criteria pass.

backend_pytest: TestHub::test_comments_add_and_delete_authz PASSED  (Ana cannot delete Luis comment -> 403; author -> 200)
frontend_playwright: Navigate /espacio: data-testid=hub-page, hub-new, hub-item-form, hub-type-note all present
Create note 'TEST_UI_Note' with tags ui,test -> appears in grid with 'Nota' badge + tags visible
Create credential 'TEST_UI_Cred' username=ui_user password=SuperSecret! -> card renders, credential-password-value shows '••••••••••' (10 bullets)
hub-search live filter: typing 'TEST_UI_Cred' shows only that card
hub-filter-credential: shows only the credential card
Cleanup hub items via UI -> grid empty
Set thresholds via API to 500/30; create personal expense (Luis, 1500 MXN, 45 days old)
Navigate /partners: alerts-banner-{partner_id} present for Luis with text 'Préstamo crítico · 6 alertas' (count includes leftover loans from prior iterations + new one)
Click Reembolso button -> modal 'Reembolso a socio' opens with 'Egresos personales pendientes' section, monto total / fecha / método / descripción / comprobante fields rendered correctly

critical_code_review_comments: server.py _reimbursed_amount_by_tx() (line ~491): correctly aggregates partials per tx_id across all reimbursements; legacy records (no partials) cap at the tx's own amount — prevents over-counting. Verified by test_three_partials_sum_to_full.

create_reimbursement validation (line ~731): dedupes source_transaction_ids, validates tx existence/type/partner ownership, computes already_per_tx from existing reimbursements, returns 409 with descriptive messages for excess or already-saldado. Edge: when partials not provided for a tx, defaults to full remaining — good UX.
delete_tx (line ~578): correctly recomputes remaining_balance via _reimbursed_amount_by_tx and blocks 409 if >0.005 outstanding. Works with partials too.

partners_portal alerts (line ~957): caps applied per-tx at tx.amount (prevents over-cap); severity logic exceeds_amount && exceeds_days -> critical, else -> warning (if either exceeded). Sort: critical first then remaining desc. Matches spec.

Hub endpoints (line ~1086): clean CRUD with $regex q over title/content/tags/url/username. Comments stored as embedded array; delete authz checks created_by_id == user.id, 403 otherwise. Good security model for partner-only workspace.
Non-blocking: server.py is now 1500+ lines — should be split into routers (auth.py, transactions.py, reimbursements.py, hub.py, partners.py) as future hygiene.
Minor UI: 'Credenciale' badge text (PartnerHub.jsx) seems to be a singular/plural error — should be 'Credencial'.
seed_data_creation: All test data was self-cleaned. Note: before iteration 9 started there were leftover personal expenses for Luis (the Préstamo card showed '6 alertas' when threshold was set to 500/30 — these are NOT from iter9; likely from prior manual test_full.py runs or iter8 carryover ($17 TEST tx id acc7f75c-1f5b-47c9-a533-186fbace34b2). Iteration 9 itself created and cleaned: 1 critical tx (cleaned via reimbursement+delete), all hub items deleted via UI. Threshold restored to default 5000/30 at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (partial reimbursements, loan alerts, Hub /espacio) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_partials_alerts_hub.py is fully idempotent and can be re-run. Leftover Luis loans from earlier runs still exist — if next iteration needs a clean state, sweep partner Luis personal expenses. Only minor UI cosmetic finding: 'Credenciale' badge typo on credential card — not blocking. Luis password remains Test2026!.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature validation, no bugs to root-cause. The earlier reimbursement duplication bug (iter 8) is still fixed; the new partial-reimbursement code reuses _reimbursed_amount_by_tx which now handles both partials map and legacy full-coverage gracefully.
